result.summary: Implemented the design at lib/letflow/design/iss0274-typecheck-solution-style-fix.md exactly, on top of web/package.json's prior state. Single-line change: web/package.json line 10 from `"type-check": "tsc --noEmit"` to `"type-check": "tsc -b tsconfig.json"`. No changes to tsconfig.app.json, tsconfig.node.json, or tsconfig.json -- confirmed by direct read before editing, matching design section 4's regression checklist. Verification (all commands run for real from web/, output quoted, not assumed): (1) `npx tsc -b tsconfig.json --listFiles 2>&1 | wc -l` -> 964 files listed, confirming type-check now walks the real src/** and vite.config.ts trees instead of the previous 0-file no-op. `npm run type-check` -> exit 0, clean, no errors. (2) Fail-then-pass regression demonstration (substitutes for a test file since this is a build-config-only change with no ExUnit/vitest surface): added `const __iss0274_deliberate_type_error: number = 'not a number'` to web/src/main.tsx, ran `npm run type-check` -> FAILED with `src/main.tsx(9,7): error TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'.` plus a TS6133 unused-var error, exit code 2 (non-zero), proving the script now catches real type errors it previously ignored unconditionally. Reverted the injected line via Edit (git diff --stat src/main.tsx showed zero diff afterward, confirming clean revert), re-ran `npm run type-check` -> exit 0, passing again. (3) `npm run build` (`tsc -b && vite build`) -> succeeded, exit 0, 384 modules transformed, dist/ produced (only pre-existing chunk-size advisory warning, unrelated to this change). (4) `npm run check` (type-check && lint && test && guards) -> full green run: type-check clean, lint clean (0 warnings, --max-warnings 0), vitest unit suite 30 files / 178 tests passed, guards suite 4 files / 48 tests passed (meta-control, source-scan, bundle-scan, role-set), all exit 0. `git status --porcelain` after all work shows only web/package.json modified (plus this handoff file and an unrelated untracked docs/issues/ISS-0274.yaml pre-existing in the tree, not touched by this task) -- working tree otherwise clean of stray files.
